### What This Does:
- **`net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_ra=2`** — Persists to `/etc/sysctl.conf`, ensuring the system **accepts IPv6 Router Advertisements even when forwarding is enabled**. (Value `2` overrides the default behavior where `accept_ra` is ignored when forwarding is on.)
- **`net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding=1`** — **Immediately enables IPv6 packet forwarding** (kernel-level, takes effect now).

### ⚠️ Notes:
- The `accept_ra=2` change is **persistent** (written to `/etc/sysctl.conf`) but **not yet applied at runtime**. To apply it now, run:
  ```bash
  sysctl -p
  ```
- The `forwarding=1` change is **runtime only** and will reset on reboot unless also added to `/etc/sysctl.conf`.
